statements: The structure of nutritional diagnosis writing (PES) consists of three components.
The first component of the PES structure is the Problem (Masalah).
The Problem component is stated with a code and a description of the problem.
An example of a Problem code and description is NI-2.9, which refers to limited food intake.
An example of a Problem code and description is NB-1.1, which refers to a lack of knowledge about nutrition.
An example of a Problem code and description is NC-4.1, which refers to energy and protein malnutrition.
The second component of the PES structure is the Etiology (Etiologi).
The Etiology component is stated with the phrase "berkaitan dengan" (related to) followed by the cause of the problem.

An example of an Etiology statement is "berkaitan dengan kondisi yang lemah pada pasien dan kesulitan mengunyah serta menelan" (related to the patient's weak condition and difficulty chewing and swallowing).
An example of an Etiology statement is "berkaitan dengan kurangnya pemahaman ibu terkait porsi makan" (related to the mother's lack of understanding regarding food portions).
An example of an Etiology statement is "berkaitan dengan asupan yang tidak adekuat dalam jangka waktu yang lama" (related to inadequate intake over a long period).
The third component of the PES structure is Signs/Symptoms (Sign/Symptom).
The Signs/Symptoms component is stated with the phrase "ditandai dengan" (indicated by) followed by clinical signs or symptoms.

An example of a Signs/Symptoms statement is "ditandai dengan pasien menggunakan selang NGT, pasien mengalami cerebral palsy grade V" (indicated by the patient using an NGT tube, the patient has grade V cerebral palsy).

An example of a Signs/Symptoms statement is "ditandai dengan asupan energi pasien tergolong defisit berat (65,9%), protein defisit sedang (72,1%), lemak defisit sedang (77,9%), KH defisit berat (57,2%)" (indicated by the patient's energy intake being severely deficient (65.9%), protein moderately deficient (72.1%), fat moderately deficient (77.9%), and carbohydrates severely deficient (57.2%)).

An example of a Signs/Symptoms statement is "ditandai dengan BB/U : P → Sangat Kurus, PB/U : P → Pendek, status gizi buruk tipe marasmus fase transisi Hb (↓), HCT (↓), Eritrosit (↓)" (indicated by Weight-for-Age: P → Very Thin, Height-for-Age: P → Short, severe malnutrition status of marasmus type in transition phase, Hemoglobin (↓), HCT (↓), Erythrocytes (↓)).

The second component of the PES structure is E, which stands for Etiology.

The third component of the PES structure is S, which stands for Signs and Symptoms.
The Signs and Symptoms component includes supporting evidence for the diagnosis, covering anthropometry, biochemical/laboratory results, clinical physical findings, and intake.
